output.summary: An ornamental shrub native to Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay, it thrives in wetlands and can form dense thickets. It bears red-orange flowers and persistent pods whose seeds rattle in the wind. The plant and its seeds are poisonous to humans and can cause severe illness or death if eaten.
output.edibilityNote: Humans who ingest the plant or its seeds may develop vomiting, diarrhea or respiratory failure, and ingestion can be fatal.
